    ACTS Common Course - MATH 2603.

Prerequisite: C or above in MATH 2924 or equivalent, or with the consent of the instructor.

Continuation of MATH 2924. The study of multi-dimensional calculus, including vector functions, partial differentiation, multiple integration and applications.

Note: A grade of C of better must be earned in this course if being used to satisfy the general education mathematics requirement.
    
</section>
